methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and verified for each vendor on 2026-06-19: tutorbird.com/pricing, teachworks.com/pricing, tutorcruncher.com/pricing/us (USD-specific page), oasesonline.com/pricing, mymusicstaff.com/pricing, and pike13.com/pricing-and-plans. All six vendors and all listed plans were confirmed to exist with the published prices stated. Teachworks uses a hybrid billing model (flat monthly base fee plus a per-student-lesson overage); all other vendors use flat monthly pricing. TutorCruncher publishes a USD /pricing/us page with three published prices ($30 / $80 / $240); the Enterprise tier IS a published price, not 'contact sales'. Corrections applied on re-verification: TutorCruncher card-processing fees were wrong in the draft (live page shows 3.85% Pay as You Go and 3.5% Startup, not 2.65%/2.3%); TutorCruncher video-conferencing overage was wrong (live page shows $0.01/participant-minute and $0.03/recorded-minute beyond the 20,000-minute allowance, not $0.008/$0.024). Pike13 annual discount (~13%) was recomputed and confirmed from published monthly vs. annual figures. Oases Online publishes no free trial on its pricing page (only a sales demo), so freeTrialDays = null. No forever-free tier exists for any vendor. All prices are in USD. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.name: TutorBird
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from tutorbird.com/pricing on 2026-06-19 and confirmed. Single flat plan at $16.95/month for the primary tutor plus $4.95/month per additional staff member; no per-student fees. 30-day free trial (no credit card), 90-day money-back guarantee. TutorBird is built by Port 443 Inc. (Canada) and is a sister product to My Music Staff.

plans.name: TutorBird
plans.notes: Single plan covering unlimited students. Each additional tutor/staff member costs $4.95/month. Includes scheduling, billing, payments, student portal, website builder, SMS reminders, and file storage. 30-day free trial (no credit card); 90-day money-back guarantee. No contracts.

limits: Additional staff members billed at $4.95/month each
No forever-free plan; 30-day trial only
keyFeatures: Flat-rate pricing with unlimited students
Built-in website builder with free hosting
SMS reminders included
90-day money-back guarantee
enrichment.provenance: Data sourced and re-verified directly from tutorbird.com/pricing on 2026-06-19. No HIPAA, SOC2, or GDPR statements found on official pages.

vendors.name: Teachworks
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from teachworks.com/pricing on 2026-06-19 and confirmed. Teachworks uses a hybrid model: flat monthly base fee plus a per-student-lesson fee; the per-lesson rate decreases at higher tiers. 21-day free trial; no forever-free plan.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Base $16.49/month plus $0.320 per student lesson (a group lesson with 3 students = 3 student lessons). Unlimited students, teachers, and user accounts. All add-ons and integrations except API. 21-day free trial.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Base $47.99/month plus $0.189 per student lesson. Includes all Starter features plus Teachworks API access. 21-day free trial.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Base $187.99/month plus $0.065 per student lesson. Includes all Growth features plus first 5 branch accounts (additional branches $35/month each). 21-day free trial.

limits: Per-student-lesson fee applies on top of base; group classes multiply the charge by number of attendees
Teachworks API access requires Growth tier or above
Multi-branch only available on Premium plan
keyFeatures: Hybrid pricing scales with actual lesson volume
Multi-branch management on Premium tier
Teachworks API for custom integrations (Growth and above)
Supports invoicing in multiple currencies
enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-verified directly from teachworks.com/pricing on 2026-06-19. No HIPAA, SOC2, or GDPR statements found on official pages.

vendors.name: TutorCruncher
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from tutorcruncher.com/pricing/us on 2026-06-19. The USD page publishes three prices: Pay as You Go $30/mo, Startup $80/mo, Enterprise $240/mo (a published price, not 'contact sales'). CORRECTION: card-processing fees in the original draft (2.65%/2.3%) were wrong; the live USD page shows 3.85% (Pay as You Go) and 3.5% (Startup), with competitive rates for Enterprise. CORRECTION: video-conferencing overage in the draft ($0.008/min, $0.024/recorded-min) was wrong; the live page shows $0.01/participant-minute and $0.03/recorded-minute beyond the 20,000-minute included allowance. 2-week free trial.

plans.name: Pay as You Go
plans.notes: For tutoring companies starting out. All core features: dashboard, client pipeline, calendar, automatic payments and payroll, email/SMS reminders. Card processing fee 3.85%. 2-week free trial.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: For scaling tutoring companies. Adds customisable dashboard, HTML email templates, user and report exports. Card processing fee 3.5%. Extra branches $50/month each. Custom domain $100/month. 2-week free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For large-scale tutoring companies. Adds custom JavaScript and CSS, Google Analytics integration, unlimited technical support including custom integrations. Competitive card processing rates for high-volume merchants. Published price ($240/mo), not contact-sales. 2-week free trial.

limits: Card processing fees: 3.85% (Pay as You Go), 3.5% (Startup); competitive rates on Enterprise. International cards +1.5%; Amex/Diners/JCB/UnionPay/prepaid +2%
Extra branches $50/month each
Custom domain hosting $100/month add-on
Video conferencing: 20,000 participant-minutes included, then $0.01/participant-minute
Lesson recordings billed at $0.03/recorded-minute
keyFeatures: Built-in tutor marketplace and client pipeline CRM
Automatic split payments and payroll for tutors
Native video conferencing with per-minute billing beyond included allowance
Custom JS/CSS and white-label options on Enterprise
enrichment.provenance: USD pricing and fees re-verified on tutorcruncher.com/pricing/us on 2026-06-19. Card-processing and video-conferencing rates corrected from the draft. No HIPAA, SOC2, or GDPR certifications stated on official pages.

vendors.name: Oases Online
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched directly from oasesonline.com/pricing on 2026-06-19 and confirmed. Six student-count tiers from $99 to $699/month; pricing auto-adjusts as active student count crosses tier thresholds. The official pricing page offers only a free, no-obligation sales demo, NOT a software free trial; freeTrialDays set to null. Over 350 students requires Enterprise contact (no published price).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Up to 25 active students. Includes scheduling, billing, invoicing, attendance, CRM, parent portal, and reporting. Tier adjusts automatically as student count changes.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Up to 60 active students. Same full feature set as Starter.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Up to 350 active students. Organizations exceeding 350 students contact sales for Enterprise pricing (no published price).

limits: Plans are defined by active student count (25 / 60 / 100 / 140 / 200 / 350)

Essential $159/mo monthly or $139/mo annual; Advanced $225/mo monthly or $195/mo annual; Premium $286/mo monthly or $249/mo annual. 7-day free trial. plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Monthly billing $159/month; annual billing $139/month (~$1,668/year). Unlimited staff seats and client profiles. Includes scheduling, check-in, waitlist, family accounts, automated billing, gift cards, business dashboard, client/staff apps, credit card surcharging. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Monthly billing $225/month; annual billing $195/month (~$2,340/year). All Essential features plus website widgets, multi-location oversight, payroll/time tracking, digital waivers, custom reporting, email marketing, analytics integration, room bookings, contactless check-in, SMS messaging. 7-day free trial.

plans.notes: Monthly billing $286/month; annual billing $249/month (~$2,988/year). All Advanced features plus custom integrations/API access, member progress tracking, plus choice of branded iOS/Android app OR custom reports. 7-day free trial.
